**Respiratory-virus detections in team-space air samples across the 2026 FIFA World Cup™.** Air was sampled continuously in Team Canada congregate spaces across five host cities from 3 June to 4 July 2026, and every filter was tested for SARS-CoV-2, influenza A, influenza B, and RSV. All cities are shown on a single continuous local-time axis. Rows are the four target viruses; each rectangle is one filter tested for one virus, drawn to its exact sampling window. Rooms are merged within each city. A box is blue if the virus was detected in any room (fill mapped to the lowest Ct across rooms), white if no room detected it but at least one returned a valid negative, and grey if every room was invalid. An asterisk beneath the axis marks a session where at least one room's run was invalid and data was not available from all sampled rooms.
